verdict.rationale: Smooth is a hosted browser-automation service, so exporting your account data and leaving is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no data-export feature, bulk export, or open export format. The closest items are a list-tasks API endpoint, per-task structured outputs, and an enterprise option to delete task data; these are developer building blocks or adjacent controls, not an export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
